changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The single owner of each agent sandbox: one row for each live sandbox of a subject, and the SandboxClaim it names.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE agent_sandbox ( id uuid NOT NULL, workspace_id bigint NOT NULL, subject_key varchar(96) NOT NULL, kind varchar(16) NOT NULL, claim_name varchar(63) NOT NULL, state varchar(12) DEFAULT 'REQUESTED' NOT NULL, created_at timestamp(6) with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, last_used_at timestamp(6) with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, shutdown_at timestamp(6) with time zone NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT agent_sandbox_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uk_agent_sandbox_workspace UNIQUE (id, workspace_id), CONSTRAINT uk_agent_sandbox_claim UNIQUE (claim_name), CONSTRAINT sfk_agent_sandbox_workspace FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspace(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CONSTRAINT ck_agent_sandbox_kind CHECK (kind IN ('REVIEW', 'CONVERSATION', 'ACTION')), CONSTRAINT ck_agent_sandbox_state CHECK (state IN ('REQUESTED', 'READY', 'DELETING')), CONSTRAINT ck_agent_sandbox_subject CHECK (length(subject_key) > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_agent_sandbox_claim_name CHECK (claim_name ~ '^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$'), CONSTRAINT ck_agent_sandbox_times CHECK (last_used_at >= created_at AND shutdown_at > created_at) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_agent_sandbox_live_subject ON agent_sandbox (workspace_id, subject_key) WHERE state IN ('REQUESTED', 'READY'); CREATE INDEX idx_agent_sandbox_state ON agent_sandbox (state, last_used_at);

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The database refuses every sandbox transition that AgentSandboxState refuses, and every change of a sandbox's identity.
changeSet.rollback: DROP TRIGGER agent_sandbox_transition ON agent_sandbox; DROP FUNCTION guard_agent_sandbox();
